source.title: 27 years of livestock production data under different stocking rate levels at the Central Grasslands Research Extension Center near Streeter, North Dakota
source.inputUnitConversion: pounds to kg with the exact factor 0.45359237

evaluation.population: yearling steers only; all eligible records retained, no CGREC model selection or parameter fitting
evaluation.observedOutcome: raw endpoint ADG derived from (final weight - initial weight) / ADG_DAYS
evaluation.engineInputs: observed initial weight and duration; default illustrative pasture state and configuration

interpretation: CGREC is a separate North Dakota research station and does not share the CPER animal cohort; the analysis is an external-site transport diagnostic.
Steer records occur in only three years (1989, 1994 and 2015); the 2015 subset is the largest year, but all eligible years are retained in the primary summary.
The default and CPER-scaled model runs use no observed pasture biomass, group stocking, weather, forage quality or supplementation inputs.
Treatment summaries are descriptive. They do not estimate causal effects of stocking rate.
This comparison covers only ADG and does not validate intake, costs, forage stock, counterfactuals, uncertainty intervals or the full simulator.
